Name: Pridematic Shards Randomizer
Author: omeganmoon
Description:
[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]Ever wished your Prismatic Shards came in a little more pride? [b]Pridematic Shards Randomizer[/b] transforms vanilla Prismatic Shards into 27 unique pride-themed designs![/color]
[color=#D4D4D8]
Each time you obtain a Prismatic Shard, it is randomized into one of 27 designs representing different LGBTQ+ identities and pride flags. These custom shards retain the functionality of the original item while bringing a little more color to your Stardew Valley experience.[/color]

[color=#D4D4D8]Collect them all and create a colorful pride collection in the Museum Basement![/color]

[size=4][b]Installation instructions[/b][/size]
[list=1]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Install the required dependencies listed below.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Download and extract Pridematic Shards Randomizer.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Open the extracted folder.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Copy both mod folders into your Stardew Valley[/color]

[code]Mods[/code][color=#D4D4D8]folder:[/color]

[list]
[*][code]Pridematic Shards Randomizer[/code][/*]
[*][code][CP] Pridematic Shards Randomizer[/code][/*]
[/list][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Make sure Pridematic Shards is installed and enabled.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Launch Stardew Valley through SMAPI.[/color][/*]
[/list]
[size=4][b]Main features[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]27 Pride Designs:[/b] Vanilla Prismatic Shards are randomized into 27 unique pride-themed designs.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]Randomized Appearance:[/b] Each newly obtained Prismatic Shard receives a randomized design.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]Individual Stacking:[/b] Matching designs stack together, while different designs remain separate.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]Museum Collection:[/b] All 27 custom designs can be donated to the museum and count toward completing the collection.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]Gift Compatibility:[/b] Custom shards retain their gift functionality and have custom gift preferences.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]Shipping:[/b] Custom shards can be shipped for 2,000g each.[/color][/*]
[/list][b]Plans for Future Updates[/b]
[list]
[*]An optional configuration setting to allow completing the Museum collection without needing to donate all 27 shard variants.[/*]
[*]Custom gift preferences based on fanon NPC ships and sexualities.[/*]
[/list]
[size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]The following mods are required:[/color]

[list]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]SMAPI 4.0.0 or later[/b][/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]Content Patcher 2.9.0 or later[/b][/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/8001]Pridematic Shards[/url] by Symtrkl[/b][/color][/*]
[*]A mod that expands the museum, such as ex[/*]
[/list]
[size=4][b]Shout outs[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8][b]Symtrkl[/b] – Creator of the original Pridematic Shards mod and pride-themed artwork. Thank you for creating the artwork that inspired this project![/color]
